acceptanceCriteria: A live docker-prefixed run qualifies the probe: container id is the run's container, or is recorded unknown when it cannot be proven
Image digest is recorded from host-side observation when available, unknown otherwise
Retained live receipt plus a test
body: V1-2010 (PR #1282, LPCV-V0-132) always records the image digest as unknown (not observable from inside the prefix) and records the probe's own container id, which need not be the run's container. NOT_RUN: real docker prefix. GitHub #1271 item 2 partly unmet.
title: Ruby provider: live container qualification of the runtime probe (image digest, run container identity)
